description: This file defines internal CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) implementation classes and functions for the Abseil C++ library, including CRC32 algorithms, constants, and utility functions.

classes.name: CRCImpl
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing CRC algorithms, providing interface for CRC computations and table initialization.

classes.name: CRC32
classes.description: Concrete implementation of CRC for 32-bit CRC calculations, supporting extend, scramble, and zero-extension operations.

methods.name: CRCImpl::NewInternal
methods.description: Creates a new internal CRC implementation instance.

methods.name: CRC::Empty
methods.description: Resets or initializes the CRC value.

methods.name: CRC32::Extend
methods.description: Extends the CRC value with additional bytes.

methods.name: CRC32::Scramble
methods.description: Applies scrambling to the CRC value for non-linearity.

methods.name: CRC32::Unscramble
methods.description: Reverses the scrambling operation on the CRC value.

methods.name: CRC32::InitTables
methods.description: Initializes lookup tables for CRC computation.
